title: Core's request to the z3 engine (/io/request.json of engines/z3)
description: Stage 1.5 step 2 (§5): satisfiability of the pre/post of S* that carry smt. The engine does not see the repo: only this request, mounted at /io, without network. Each function is resolved separately with its concatenated SMT-LIB 2 fragments; timeout_ms is the cap per function.
